sloka: इत्येवं वादिनं वीरमभिनन्द्य स राघवः ।लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिसम्पन्नमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४१.१० ।।।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ vādinaṁ vīramabhinandya sa rāghavaḥ ।lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmisampannamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.41.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Raghava heard the hero Sugriva, applauding him and spoke these words to Lakshmana, who was endowed with prosperity.
